title: ReactionComponent
description: Comprehensive specification of a single chemical component used in an enzymatic reaction, including its identity, role, quantity, source, and storage requirements.

amount.title: amount
amount.description: Quantity or concentration of the component used in the reaction.

identity.title: identity
identity.description: Chemical identification and characterization of the component.

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes or comments about the component.

provenance.title: provenance
provenance.description: Source and supplier information for the component.

role.title: role
role.description: What this component does in the reaction (substrate, cosubstrate, salt, ...).

solubility.title: solubility
solubility.description: Solubility characteristics of the component under reaction conditions.

storage.title: storage
storage.description: Storage requirements and conditions for the component.

AmountConcentration.title: AmountConcentration
AmountConcentration.description: Quantitative specification of component amount or concentration used in the reaction.

unit.title: unit
unit.description: Unit of measurement for the amount or concentration.

value.title: value
value.description: Numerical value of the amount or concentration.

ComponentIdentity.title: ComponentIdentity
ComponentIdentity.description: Chemical identification and characterization information for a component, including names, structural identifiers, and physical properties.

formulation.title: formulation
formulation.description: Physical form or formulation of the component (powder, liquid, solution, etc.).

identifiers.title: identifiers
identifiers.description: One or more identifiers like CAS, PubChem CID, InChI, etc.

name.title: name
name.description: Common or systematic name of the component.

purity.title: purity
purity.description: Purity of the component as a percentage or fraction.

smiles.title: smiles
smiles.description: SMILES (Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System) notation for the chemical structure.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Source and supplier information for component traceability and reproducibility.

supplier.title: supplier
supplier.description: Supplier/manufacturer or "prepared in lab"; include product code or citation if applicable.

SolubilityLimit.title: SolubilityLimit
SolubilityLimit.description: Solubility characteristics of the component under specific conditions.

unit.title: unit
unit.description: Unit of measurement for the solubility limit.

value.title: value
value.description: Numerical value of the solubility limit.

StorageConditions.title: StorageConditions
StorageConditions.description: Conditions under which materials (biocatalysts, components, etc.) are stored to maintain stability and integrity.

additives.title: additives
additives.description: Any additives or stabilizers used during storage (e.g., glycerol, stabilizers, preservatives).

drying_method.title: drying_method
drying_method.description: Method used to dry the material if stored in dry form (optional, primarily for biocatalysts).

notes.title: notes
notes.description: Additional notes about storage conditions or requirements.

storage_start.title: storage_start
storage_start.description: Date when storage under these conditions began or material was received.

temperature_unit.title: temperature_unit
temperature_unit.description: Unit for the storage temperature (e.g., °C, K).
